using Volo.Abp.DependencyInjection;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.Tests
{
    public class SuiteCommandTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void StartSuite_WhenPortIsAlreadyInUse_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>>();
            var suiteCommand = new Mock<SuiteCommand>(
                Mock.Of<AbpNuGetIndexUrlService>(),
                Mock.Of<PackageVersionCheckerService>(),
                Mock.Of<ICmdHelper>(),
                Mock.Of<AuthService>(),
                Mock.Of<CliHttpClientFactory>(),
                Mock.Of<SuiteAppSettingsService>()
            )
            {
                Logger = loggerMock.Object
            };

            suiteCommand.Setup(x => x.IsPortAlreadyInUse()).Returns(true);

            // Act
            suiteCommand.Object.StartSuite();

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogError(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains($"Port \"{suiteCommand.Object._abpSuitePort}\" is already in use.")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.Is<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>((v, t) => true)),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
